title: Pah Vung Wei

page_data.en:
No
648
17/10/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
October 18th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
In consequence of the action of the French
Police in disbanding the meeting of the destitute
rebels in the Zee Oon 安 teashop on Rue Kraetzer on the
14th inst they now meet in four teashops near the
West Gate. On the 15th inst they sent a deputation
to again interview the officers of the Repatriation
Office. General Yang was communicated with by
telephone and sent two staff officers who visited
the various teashops and explained to the rebels who
number about 1000 that funds will be forthcoming
very soon. Meanwhile the shopkeepers in the vicinity
became alarmed and telephoned to General Yang for troops
to be sent to the scene. A Company was sent about
noon but the officer in charge soon withdrew on
finding the rebels quiet and orderly. The shopkeepers
gave the soldiers a present of $50 for their trouble
much to the indignation of the rebels who pointed out to
them that they had often begged for money and could
not get it from them.
Pah Vung Wei 柏文蔚, rebel leader who is now
living at 284 Ya Bing Li 雅平里 Frenchtown has issued
a circular asking the rebels not to bother him with their
affairs as he is very sick and will take no further
interest in their affairs.
It is reported that a newspaper to be named the
Ming Tuh Pao 民德报 will shortly be published in Shanghai,
the general manager being Zung Zing An 陳靜安 ex-
military advisor to the Chekiang Tutuh. The paper
is to be run in the interests of General Chang Hsun.
There is still no settlement of the painters
strike.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧手写批注：少 16/10）

编号
648
17/10/16
上海工部局。
1916年10月18日
（印：上海工部局警务处）

警务处，
（侦探股。）

先生：

鉴于法国巡捕于本月14日在克勒策尔路（Rue Kraetzer）的“安”茶馆（Zee Oon 安 teashop）驱散了贫困叛乱分子的集会，他们现在改在西门附近的四家茶馆集会。本月15日，他们派遣代表团再次面见遣返办公室的官员。已通过电话与杨将军取得联系，他派出了两名参谋军官走访各家茶馆，并向约1000名叛乱分子解释称，资金很快将会到位。与此同时，附近店主感到恐慌，致电杨将军请求派兵前往现场。中午时分派出了一连士兵，但负责军官发现叛乱分子安静有序，随即撤走。店主们为慰劳士兵赠予50元，此举引起叛乱分子的极大愤慨，他们指出自己曾多次乞讨却未能从店主处得到分文。

现居法租界雅平里284号的叛乱首领柏文蔚（Pah Vung Wei）发布通告，要求叛乱分子勿以其事务相扰，称其病重，不再关心他们的事务。

据报，一份名为《民德报》（Ming Tuh Pao）的报纸即将在上海出版，总经理为前浙江督军军事顾问陈静安（Zung Zing An）。该报将为张勋将军的利益服务。

油漆工罢工事件仍无解决。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警察总监上尉。

（左侧手写批注：少 16/10）
